notes.title: Bad Business Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079440/Bad_Business/

Did you ever want to be a rabbit that is also a hitman? Well have we got great news for you then, because Bad Business is out now!!

Bad Business is an extremely challenging top-down tactical shooter game where Mr. Bunny Rabbit, a hitman for the Mob, has been tasked to neutralize the rival Gang. A hard task for any organization, an impossible task for a hitman.

Be sure to join us on [url=discord.hut90.com]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=twitter.com/Hut_90]Twitter[/url] for all the latest news about Bad Business and all our other games.

[b]If you like the game, consider leaving us a [url=store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/1079440]review[/url] or recommending the game to your friends.[/b]

Hi everyone,

Welcome to [b]Bad Business![/b]

Bad Business is an extremely challenging top-down tactical shooter game where Mr. Bunny Rabbit, a hitman for the Mob, has been tasked to neutralize the rival Gang. A hard task for any organization, an impossible task for a hitman.

notes.title: Retool Is a Finalist for the TIGA Awards 2016
notes.notes:
We forgot to mention this last week, but better later than never. We are proud to announce that Retool was selected as a finalist for the [url=tiga.org/awards/2016-categories]TIGA Awards 2016[/url]. It was selected for the puzzle category and will be competing against other great puzzle games, such as Hue and Soul Axiom.

We also want to take this moment to thank everyone who has supported us and bought this game. We really appreciate this.

notes.title: Version 1.02 – The One with the Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Retool now has Steam Trading cards! Apart from that big change, the rest are quite small. They can be seen below. As always, let us know if you have any issues with this build of the game.

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
    [*]Optimized game
    [*]Updated main menu
    [*]Minor tweaks on levels
[/list]

We also want to let you know that we have put an indefinite hold on the training/tutorial levels. Our plan is to start working on them again once we have the Xbox One version of the game completed and there is still a demand for them.

notes.title: There is a demo available
notes.notes:
Just to let everyone who doesn't know already, there is a demo of Retool available. I would recommend everyone trying the demo before they purchase Retool so that they know:
[olist]
    [*]The game works on their system
    [*]If they like the gameplay
[/olist]
The first point is the most important. It is nothing worse than buying a game to find out it does not work on your system.

Anyways, enjoy the game and report any bugs you find so that we can fix them for you.

Thanks.

[b]Update:[/b]
Demo should be working now. Thanks to user th_pion notifying us about the problem.
